<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A closing call to action: a heading, one sentence and one or two links. Axes: layout (card, band, split
  picture, row: heading beside the button in a card), tone, actions (one, two, form: an email field), proof
  (none, quote), density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { CtaQuote } from "./cta-band.types";
  import type { ActionSet } from "../components/cta-actions.types";

  export type CtaBandProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    actions: ActionSet;
    quote?: CtaQuote;
    layout?: "card" | "band" | "split" | "row" | "banner";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    proof?: "none" | "quote";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Card from "../compose/Card.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../compose/CardContent.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import CtaActions from "../components/cta-actions.svelte";
  import CtaBanner from "../blocks/cta-banner.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import QuoteProof from "../components/quote-proof.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    text,
    actions,
    quote,
    layout = "card",
    tone = "muted",
    proof = "none",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: CtaBandProps = $props();
  const center = $derived(((layout as string) === "band") || ((layout as string) === "banner"));
</script>

{#if ((layout as string) === "banner")}
  <CtaBanner
    id={id}
    title={title}
    text={text}
    cta={actions.cta}
    href={actions.href}
    tone={tone}
    landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
  />
{:else if ((layout as string) === "row")}
  <Block
    tag="section"
    class="py-8"
    aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : tpl("{0}-title", id))}
    data-testid="section"
    data-tone={tone}
    data-density={density}
    aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4" data-slot="container">
      <Card variant="muted">
        <CardContent class="flex flex-col gap-4 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
          <Stack gap="2" class="min-w-0">
            <Title as={2} size="2xl" weight="bold" id={tpl("{0}-title", id)}>
              {title}
            </Title>
            <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {text}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          {#if ((proof as string) === "quote")}
            <QuoteProof quote={quote?.text} quoteBy={quote?.by} center={center} />
          {/if}
          <CtaActions id={id} actions={actions} center={center} />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Container>
  </Block>
{:else}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={text}
    layout={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "split" : "stack")}
    align={(center ? "center" : "start")}
    boxed={((layout as string) === "card")}
    media={{ show: ((layout as string) === "split") }}
    tone={tone}
    density={density}
    landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
  >
    {#if ((proof as string) === "quote")}
      <QuoteProof quote={quote?.text} quoteBy={quote?.by} center={center} />
    {/if}
    <CtaActions id={id} actions={actions} center={center} />
    {#snippet aside()}
      <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
